notes: Crew-hour model: contractor payout cost is based on total crew time, not crew size.

Joiners align to rafters; one joiner line per rafter.
Total linear metres of joiner required (cut lengths), excluding waste.

rafter_length_multiplier.recommended_function: mult = clamp(0.85, 1.30, 1.0 + 0.06 * (rafter_length_m - 3.0)); rafter_length_m should be sloped rafter length (span_m / cos(pitch_deg)).
rafter_length_multiplier.notes: Use rafter_length_m = derived.projection_m (no overhang). Gentle scaling; at 6m gives ~1.19×.

rafter_length_loading_curve.recommended_function: minutes_per_m = linear_interpolate(points, rafter_cut_length_m); total extra minutes = total_installed_rafter_length_m * weighted_average(minutes_per_m across rafter groups).
rafter_length_loading_curve.notes: Additional rafter labour loading. Version 1.9 preserves the 2m and 3m rates, then increases the 4m, 5m and 6m rates with linear interpolation between points. Uses cut lengths where available and weights by total installed rafter metres.
